[EN] Humans always recover quickly.

In Highwatch, in the Veritas Vault, there is a document describing how miserable the humans were when they were wandering the world.

I come from the far North, where I have been studying the history of humans.

I was planning to return home once my research was finished, but I fear I might never return.
[ES] Los humanos siempre se recuperan rápidamente.

En Highwatch, en la Bóveda de Veritas, hay un documento que describe lo miserables que eran los humanos cuando vagaban por el mundo.

Vengo del extremo norte, donde he estado estudiando la historia de los humanos.

Planeaba regresar a casa una vez terminada mi investigación, pero temo que tal vez nunca regrese.
